summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would narrow Commonwealth compulsory land acquisition powers by adding specific public purpose requirements to the existing framework for ministerial acquisition declarations under land legislation.
A declaration would need to serve the Australian public directly or enable an acquiring authority to provide necessary public services that otherwise would not be provided.
The bill would start on Royal Assent, with acquisitions already covered by earlier pre-acquisition declarations or certificates excluded from the new requirements under its application provision.
changes: A new section 41A would set limits specifically for acquisition by compulsory process.
The existing declaration power would be made expressly subject to the new section as well as section 42.
The minister making a declaration would carry responsibility for satisfying the additional public purpose requirements.
summary.affected: Landholders, acquiring Commonwealth authorities and ministers responsible for compulsory acquisition declarations would be affected.
